repos.name: Linux-For-Android
repos.blurb: Runs a real Linux desktop (Ubuntu, Debian, Kali, Arch, Fedora, openSUSE, Void, Alpine) on Android through Termux, with no root. Verified across Android 5.1 to 16.

repos.name: pocketdesk
repos.blurb: Streams a Linux desktop to a phone and drives it remotely. Rust host, native Android client, built end to end in GitHub Actions.

repos.name: linux-on-esp32
repos.blurb: A NOMMU Linux environment for the ESP32-S3 microcontroller, with Wi-Fi and I2C support.

repos.name: NanoNAS-S3
repos.blurb: ESP32-S3 network storage with a Material UI, chunked background copies and fast SDMMC I/O.

repos.name: FluxMedia
repos.blurb: Published Python module and PyPI package: a LAN QR share portal plus a media player. Shipped with AUR, deb and rpm packages.

repos.name: pdev
repos.blurb: A small programming language written in Python with Hinglish keywords: a CLI, worked examples, tests and a VS Code extension, under the GPL.
